outcome: umbilical cord blood retinol binding protein (RBP) levels
retinol deficiency in the study population
cohort: The study included 44 preterm infants with a gestational age of <30 weeks and their mothers.
finding: Umbilical cord blood retinol levels were significantly higher than maternal retinol levels, suggesting compensatory mechanisms (e.g., increased placental RBP) support fetal retinol presentation even with maternal deficiency.
